response.text: Your goal is to fix the n8n workflow so the full file lands every night with retries and a Slack message if it still fails. To achieve this, I will first audit the existing n8n workflow and analyze the 429 Too Many Requests error from Google Sheets API. Second, I will implement rate limiting, batching, or pagination logic in n8n to respect Google Sheets API limits. I did nearly this for a lead intake automation with n8n: lead entry dropped from about 2 hours a week to under 10 minutes. Are you using self-hosted n8n or n8n Cloud? Let us discuss the full plan over chat.
